candidates.change_summary: Delete the statement assigning owner, so calling owned() no longer changes the owner.
Assign the zero address to owner instead of msg.sender.
Invert the require check so non-owners can call owned() and take ownership.
Remove the `_;` placeholder so the guarded function body (and its owner assignment) never executes.
Delete the statement `totalSupply -= _value;` so burn no longer reduces totalSupply.
Replace `totalSupply -= _value;` with `totalSupply += _value;` so burn increases totalSupply instead of decreasing it.
Delete the statement that decrements the caller's balance, so burn() no longer reduces balanceOf.
Invert the burn balance check so burn always reverts and no balance change ever occurs.
Delete the `_;` placeholder from the onlyOwner modifier so guarded functions (including burn) execute no body and never change balances.
Change the transfer crediting line to double the amount credited, so a prior transfer leaves different balances that persist after a subsequent burn call.
Delete the frozen-recipient check so transfers to frozen accounts succeed, leaving a different balanceOf at that key after a subsequent burn.
